body: REDGARDEN commit d2e30bb. S170-96's hero-name labels started calling arena_hero_name() but arena_ai_bridge.c was never added to the mingw cross-compile step -- CI red on every commit since, confirmed via the Actions API (e53ee5f failed). No valid Windows build existed for the founder to download. Fixed the workflow and verified with a local mingw cross-compile, 0 errors.
title: CI hard-broken by missing arena_ai_bridge.c in mingw link -- fixed
